title: Forsake Me Not When My Strength Is Spent

questions.question: In you, O Lord, do I take refuge; let me never be put to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:1 (ESV): "In you, O Lord, do I take refuge; let me never be put to shame!"

questions.question: In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me; incline your ear to me, and do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:2 (ESV): "...incline your ear to me, and save me!"

questions.question: Be to me a rock of refuge, to which I may continually what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:3 (ESV): "Be to me a rock of refuge, to which I may continually come;"

questions.question: For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O Lord, from my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:5 (ESV): "For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O Lord, from my youth."

questions.question: Upon you I have leaned from before my birth; you are he who took me from my mother's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:6 (ESV): "...you are he who took me from my mother's womb."

questions.question: I have been as a portent to many, but you are my strong what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:7 (ESV): "I have been as a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge."

questions.question: My mouth is filled with your praise, and with your glory all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:8 (ESV): "My mouth is filled with your praise, and with your glory all the day."

questions.question: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:9 (ESV): "...forsake me not when my strength is spent."

questions.question: For my enemies speak concerning me; those who watch for my life consult how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:10 (ESV): "...those who watch for my life consult together,"

questions.question: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste into my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:12 (ESV): "O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!"

questions.question: But I will hope continually and will praise you yet more and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:14 (ESV): "But I will hope continually and will praise you yet more and more."

questions.question: I will come and tell of your mighty deeds, O Lord God; I will remind them of your righteousness, yours what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:16 (ESV): "...I will remind them of your righteousness, yours alone."

questions.question: So even to old age and gray hairs, O God, do not forsake me, until I proclaim your might to another what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:18 (ESV): "...until I proclaim your might to another generation,"

questions.question: You who have made me see many troubles and calamities will revive me again; from the depths of the earth you will bring me up what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:20 (ESV): "...from the depths of the earth you will bring me up again."

questions.question: My lips will shout for joy, when I sing praises to you; my soul also, which you have what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 71:23 (ESV): "...my soul also, which you have redeemed."

key_verse_text: For you, O Lord, are my hope, my trust, O Lord, from my youth.
